parts.text: $KEY Q3 2026: revenue $2.1B, +8% Y/Y, supported by growth across priority fee-based businesses including investment banking and wealth management. Operating margin reached 36.0%, with net earnings of $579M. #earnings #banks
$TOST Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.0B, +21% Y/Y, as recurring gross profit streams grew 27% and locations expanded to 189k. Operating margin 8.3%; operating cash flow $198M. #earnings #tech

$PRIM Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.0B, -10% Y/Y, as lower renewables activity in the Energy segment weighed on results. Operating margin 4.9%; net earnings $51M and operating cash flow $140M. #earnings #industrials
$IFF Q3 2026: revenue $1.9B, +4% Y/Y, driven by volume growth across all segments. Operating margin 8.2% as SG&A and regulatory costs increased. #earnings #materials

$VSNT Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, -4% Y/Y, as linear distribution and advertising declined due to lower subscriber levels and fewer events. Operating margin 6.9%; operating cash flow $346M. #earnings #media
$HNI Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, +133% Y/Y, driven by the acquisition of Steelcase. Operating margin 8.6%; operating cash flow $195M. #earnings #consumer
$RRX Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, +6% Y/Y, driven by growth in Automation & Motion Control. Operating margin 5.1%, with a net loss recorded after a segment goodwill impairment. #earnings #industrials

$JXN Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +9% Y/Y, driven by annuity and insurance products as an aging U.S. population transitions into retirement. Operating margin 53.8%; operating cash flow $1.4B. #earnings #insurance
$IT Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, -1% Y/Y, with the decrease primarily due to the sale of the Digital Markets business. Operating margin 18.7%. #earnings #industrials
$PACS Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +12% Y/Y, driven by facility acquisitions and transitional care growth. Operating margin 6.7%; operating cash flow $211M. #earnings #healthcare
$ECG Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.4B, +40% Y/Y, driven by electrical and mechanical segment growth and data center demand. Operating margin 8.8%; net earnings $92M. #earnings #industrials
$MCY Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, -13% Y/Y, with an operating margin of -1.7% as operating costs outpaced revenue. Net loss reached $14M, while operating cash flow stood at $387M. #earnings #insurance
